scope: Shared builder Home preview selection and product parsing
causes: A photo-less catalog product caused the whole product section to be discarded before rendering.
Empty collections had no mounted preview target.
Fractional alignment could land inside a long product grid instead of at its heading.
The 15-second startup timeout repeatedly aborted healthy cold downloads on the slow connection; explicit errors still retry immediately and the startup guard now allows 180 seconds.

automated.cms_preview_interactions: 5 passed: repeated forward/backward selection, long section alignment, empty collection targets, idle scheduling, mouse dragging and distant geometry

concurrent_work: Merged remote UI-control changes; deployment stages from current live assets and checks original hashes before activation.

results: Each card immediately received mint selection styling
Preview aligned selected section at its heading
Repeated selection restored the same section after manual scroll
Mouse wheel and drag both moved the phone contents
Photo-less products retained their real prices and existing image placeholder
browser_verification.live_runtime: passed: ALL PRODUCTS -> New User Zone -> ALL PRODUCTS on canonical index.html after activation; heading and mint card highlight visibly matched every click
browser_verification.cold_load: First attempt exceeded the startup guard on this slow connection; the following attempt completed. Subsequent card selection needed no reload.
